name: Stalker: Obeschanie
source:
Stalker Fagrus, in the company of his faithful friends, sets out in search of the cache of his deceased comrade. Will their journey be that simple? Will the heroes survive and will Fargus fulfill his promise to his friend?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241224123342/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.org.stalker]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
潜猎者法格鲁斯在他忠实的朋友的陪伴下出发寻找他已故战友的藏身处。他们的旅程会这么简单吗？英雄们能否幸存下来，法格斯能否履行对朋友的承诺？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241224123342/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.org.stalker]Google Play[/url]]
